## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install pm_model in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure pm_model package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to pm_model
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/jinhyukchoi/pm-model):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/jinhyukchoi/pm-model.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/jinhyukchoi/pm-model)

``` sh
$ conda install -c jinhyukchoi pm_model
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/pm-model/)

``` sh
$ pip install pm_model
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/jinhyukchoi/pm-model)’s
[pages](https://jinhyukchoi.github.io/pm-model/). Additionally you can
find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/jinhyukchoi/pm-model) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/pm-model/) respectively.
